results.name: delayed import cannot stack over acceptance or transfer acceptance to another result
opening reset cancels pending import before either cancellation or confirmed clearing
opening restore cancels pending import without changing saved or current work until chosen
cancelled file failures cannot overwrite active accept/reset/restore confirmation or status
acceptance is bound to its exact result; stale and repeated confirmation events cannot change replaced work
a fresh import after interruption still confirms normally; superseded reads and Escape cannot resurrect candidates
queued close callbacks cannot steal the next field focus or route result edits into feedback
interrupted-operation dialogs retain mobile/desktop focus, reflow and accessible controls
